$comment: Fitted quadratic planting-date yield response for Iowa corn, transcribed from Table 2 of the publication named in `source`. yield = b0 + b1*x + b2*x^2, where x is the transformed day-of-year described in `x_transform`. Coefficients are the paper's own; relative yield and days-after-optimum are computed from them in engine/timeliness.py rather than stored, so nothing here is a derived number. The PDF is NOT archived in this repository: it is a journal article, not an extension publication.

source.citation: Abendroth, L.J., K.P. Woli, A.J.W. Myers, and R.W. Elmore. 2017. Yield-Based Corn Planting Date Recommendation Windows for Iowa. Crop, Forage & Turfgrass Management 3(1):1-7.
source.publisher_url_note: Publisher host (acsess.onlinelibrary.wiley.com) returns HTTP 403 to scripted clients; the Semantic Scholar mirror was fetched instead and verified to be the correct paper by its title, author list, and abstract text after extraction.
source.table: Table 2 (coefficients and optimum DOY); Table 3 (98-100% and 95-100% windows, used only to check this transcription in tests, not stored here)
source.trial: 18 site-year randomized complete block field trial (3-4 reps) at six Iowa State University Research and Demonstration Farms (2006, 2007, 2009); five planting dates per site-year, target planting dates between 1 April and 1 June (DOY 91-152) in 15-day increments.

x_transform: Planting date was transformed to an adjusted DOY by subtracting the date in the middle (DOY 120, i.e. 30 April) of the target planting-date range and dividing by 40: x = (DOY_original - 120) / 40. The paper states this was done 'to allow model convergence and have the intercept be easily interpreted' (Statistical Analysis section). The fitted model is y = b0 + b1*x + b2*x^2, i.e. the quadratic term is x^2, not DOY_original^2.
